title: Last night
content: Last night I was in a house that was rotting with trash and people lived there. The floor was soft with garbage and I was wondering why they were ok with living in that. I was worried there was rats. There was a guy about mid 50s with a white dress shirt on, good looking though, trying to hump me lol. My husband was there and watching. I asked him this morning if he had a dream like that last night and he didn’t remember. It was bizarre. I can’t remember what else happened but anyone have that dream last night?
